topics.name: File management and analysis
topics.description: Members request operations on existing files, including copying, renaming, moving, searching, counting, or calculating values.

topics.name: File content transformations
topics.description: Members request creating, merging, sorting, or comparing file contents, rather than simply renaming, counting, or copying a file.

topics.name: International travel service activation
topics.description: Members request enabling roaming or adding international calling services for travel or international calling, unlike general plan changes or data troubleshooting.

topics.name: Mobile plan changes
topics.description: Members seek to change, upgrade, or select a mobile data plan, including choosing a lower-cost option.

topics.name: Restore mobile connectivity
topics.description: The members seek to diagnose, troubleshoot, or restore unavailable or slow mobile service or data connectivity.

topics.name: Call and text troubleshooting
topics.description: Members seek help resolving failures involving outgoing or incoming calls or text-message delivery, rather than a complete loss of mobile service.

topics.name: Birth-order comparisons
topics.description: These members ask which of two people was born earlier.

topics.name: Geographic and venue facts
topics.description: The members seek factual information about places, landmarks, populations, areas, or sports venues, including comparisons, locations, capacities, and opening details.

topics.name: Historical and cultural fact lookup
topics.description: Members seek identification or factual details such as dates, founders, creators, works, places, or related attributes.

topics.name: Order management requests
topics.description: Members seek to cancel, update delivery details for, or track the status of an order.

topics.name: Returns, refunds, or replacements
topics.description: Members seek a post-purchase remedy through returning an item, obtaining a refund or price adjustment, or receiving a replacement.

topics.name: Flight booking changes
topics.description: Members share an intent to modify an existing flight booking, including rebooking or changing departure arrangements.

topics.name: Cancellation and refund requests
topics.description: Members seek to cancel a flight booking and obtain, request, or verify a refund, unlike the contrasts that seek flight changes.
